name: Spotlight
author: E. T. Carter
description: A single stage spotlight in a haze-filled black box. The lamp hangs above the top edge right of centre and its cone drops through rolling haze to land as a soft-edged elliptical pool on a dark glossy plank floor, the pool left flat and even as negative space for a wordmark. Behind it a velvet drape hangs in broad folds that catch the haze and reflect faintly in the boards. Dust motes twinkle and drift only inside the beam, the boards catch a warm spill, and the lamp sways just enough that the pool breathes at its edge.

params.label: Pool width
params.effect: Width of the floor pool in CSS pixels, widening the cone with it; small is a tight follow spot, large floods most of the stage.

params.label: Haze
params.effect: Density of the haze the beam lights; 0 leaves only the pool on the floor, 2 is a thick smoky cone.

params.label: Dust
params.effect: Brightness of the motes drifting through the beam; 0 clears the air entirely.

params.label: Haze drift
params.effect: How fast the haze rolls through the room and across the beam; 0 freezes the smoke.

params.label: Lamp sway
params.effect: Amplitude of the slow lamp sway that moves the cone and pool together; 0 locks the spot.
